sources.name: Building Data Genome Project 2
sources.upstreamPublisher: Building Data Genome Project / BUDS Lab

repository.note: Small deterministic prepared subsets may be committed under data/external/bdg2 with attribution and ShareAlike compliance; the full v1.0 archive stays upstream on Zenodo.

sources.attribution: Building Data Genome Project 2 / BUDS Lab; licensed under CC-BY-SA-4.0. Preserve source and licence notices.
notes: ShareAlike obligations apply to adaptations of the licensed work.
The canonical v1.0 data release is Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.3887306.
The GitHub data paths are Git LFS pointers; preparation must fetch real data from the upstream release rather than treating pointer files as meter data.
Do not vendor the full ~595 MB release archive in ClimateChain.

evidence.finding: Pinned BDG2 v1.0 release used by ClimateChain; archive buds-lab/building-data-genome-project-2-v1.0.zip with published MD5 44393dc4cf61e84dec105e955368c890.

sources.name: Carbon Data Intelligence (CaDI)

licence.name: Carbon Footprint Ltd website Terms & Conditions

repository.note: Do not mirror CaDI pages or bulk data. Preserve source URLs and retrieve/display only what the demo is permitted to reference.

sources.attribution: Carbon Data Intelligence (CaDI), brought to you by Carbon Footprint Ltd. Link to the original public record.
notes: CaDI describes itself as free to use/free to disclose, but Carbon Footprint Ltd's website terms restrict distribution and commercial use of website material.
Treat public visibility as evidence availability, not as an open-data licence.
Request permission before bulk harvesting or redistribution.

evidence.finding: CaDI presents itself as an open-access public carbon-data platform.
Website material is stated to be for personal use and not for distribution or commercial use.

sources.name: CarbonPlan OffsetsDB registry data

licence.name: CarbonPlan Terms of Data Access plus registry-specific terms

repository.note: Do not vendor OffsetsDB snapshots until the selected registries' terms are audited. Use source links and processing scripts.

sources.attribution: CarbonPlan OffsetsDB and the relevant upstream carbon registry/registries.
